items.title: Projeto elétrico industrial básico
items.subtitle: Fundamentos, dimensionamento e documentação técnica
items.publisher: Angra dos Reis: Editora Argus Kepheus
items.subjects: Electrical engineering · Electrical design · Industrial installations
items.coverAlt: Cover of the book Projeto elétrico industrial básico, by Sergio Cordero Calvimontes
items.abstract: Instructional book for training in electrical and electronic engineering, focused on the design of low-voltage industrial electrical installations: load surveys and load schedules, demand calculation, sizing of conductors and protective devices, single-line and three-line diagrams, and technical documentation. Intended for technical students, teachers and professionals in training.

items.title: Gateways
items.subtitle: Coleta, processamento e transmissão de dados
items.subjects: Industrial automation · Edge computing · Internet of Things (IoT) · Communication networks
items.note: A multilingual work: each language will be an independent edition with its own ISBN. The first edition, in Portuguese, is in preparation.
items.abstract: “Gateways: Coleta, processamento e transmissão de dados” offers a comprehensive view of the central link in modern automation networks. The book explores, in a practical and detailed way, everything from hardware architecture to the integration of fundamental industrial protocols such as Modbus, MQTT and OPC UA. Its goal is to enable automation engineers, IoT developers and systems architects to design, configure and maintain physical and logical gateways in industrial environments, smart grids and clinical telemetry, incorporating convergence, security and edge computing orchestration strategies.
